name: Databasus
description: Databasus is a free, open source and self-hosted tool to backup PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MongoDB.
composeYaml:
services:
  databasus:
    image: 'databasus/databasus:v3.16.2'
    environment:
    volumes:
      - 'databasus-data:/databasus-data'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - wget
        - '-qO-'
        - 'http://localhost:4005/api/v1/system/health'
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
